title: Sudden Cardiac Death in Athletes
claims: The review states that the ESC and the International Olympic Committee advocate screening that includes a resting 12-lead ECG, in contrast to American recommendations.
The review states that ECG-inclusive screening appears to increase the sensitivity of pre-participation screening for identifying cardiovascular disorders that predispose to sudden cardiac death.
The review describes ongoing debate about the optimal mechanism for sudden cardiac death prevention, including the role of ECG and cardiac imaging.
The review notes that false-positive results and cost remain concerns for ECG-inclusive screening.
